title: ICNT
description: Shows the held item icon, total count of matching items, and durability on the HUD. Configure display position, warnings, sounds, and durability safety options through Mod Menu
body:
## ICNT (Inventory Count Tool)

ICNT is a lightweight Fabric client-side HUD mod for Minecraft 1.21.8.  
It shows the icon of the currently held item, the total count of matching items in your inventory, and (for damageable tools) remaining durability directly on screen.

This mod is designed for players who want fast, readable inventory awareness during combat, mining, and exploration, without opening inventory screens.  
All settings are available in **Mod Menu** with a GUI, so no commands are required.

## Main Features

- Held item icon + live total count display
- Optional durability text for tools
- Configurable HUD layout:
  - anchor position
  - free-position mode
  - X/Y offsets
  - drag-based position editor
- Multiple display styles (compact / detailed)
- Warning system:
  - caution and warning durability thresholds
  - warning text display
  - configurable warning sounds (volume/cooldown)
- Safety option to block tool use at durability 1

## Smart Item Matching

ICNT counts items using item data-aware matching:

- Different potion effects are **not** merged
- Different enchantments are **not** merged
- Items with the same type but different components are counted separately

This means your displayed count reflects the exact variant you are holding, not just the base item ID.

## Compatibility

- Loader: **Fabric**
- Minecraft: **1.21.8**
- Environment: **Client-side**

## Notes

- This mod only affects client HUD and local feedback.
- It does not require server-side installation.
